_: The King's sheet and his family (royal_sheet.gd; CK3's ruler window), opened from the bar's heading. Each line's words; {name}, {age}, {traits}, {house}, {how} are filled from /world royals (bridge royals.js). nature_tip: why his nature matters at court; regency: while a child is King; no_heir: with none; abdicate_tip: what stepping down does.
none: The royal house is not yet known.
nature_tip: Lords of a like nature warm to him; those of the opposite nature cool. A new King is measured again by every lord.
regency: A child sits the throne. Until he comes of age the realm is held by a regent, and cold lords rise more readily.
no_heir: There is no heir. If the King dies so, the crown is up for the taking.
abdicate_tip: The heir is of age. The crown passes to him now, and every lord takes his measure afresh.
funeral: The great houses swore to the old King, not to this one. Old friends wait to be won again, and old grudges are half forgotten.
pledge_tag: Your word. Kept, it is remembered warmly; broken, bitterly.
news_broken: The King's word is broken: {text}. They will remember it.
